name: The Portman Ritz-Carlton, Shanghai
insider_take: This towering luxury landmark in Nanjing West Road seamlessly blends timeless Ritz-Carlton elegance with Shanghai's dynamic energy, offering unparalleled access to the city's premier shopping and business districts.
whats_special: The hotel occupies floors 1-37 of the iconic Portman Shanghai Centre, featuring the city's largest hotel rooms averaging 54 square meters. Its prime location sits atop the Shanghai Centre shopping arcade and connects directly to the metro system. The property houses Shanghai's only indoor tennis court within a luxury hotel and boasts panoramic city views from its club-level floors.
pro_tip: Book a Club Level room for exclusive access to the 37th-floor lounge with stunning Huangpu River views and complimentary evening cocktails – it's one of the highest hotel lounges in central Shanghai.
dont_miss: The legendary Sunday Jazz Brunch at Palladio Restaurant, a Shanghai institution for over two decades. Take advantage of the hotel's direct underground connection to Jing'an Temple metro station, and explore the nearby historic Jing'an Temple, one of Shanghai's most famous Buddhist temples, just a 5-minute walk away.
pros: Prime location in Shanghai's financial district with metro connectivity
Legendary Ritz-Carlton service and attention to detail
Spacious rooms with modern amenities and city views
Multiple dining options including award-winning restaurants
cons: Busy urban location may lack tranquil atmosphere
